name: MosaicDissolveSlides
job: Move between slides by flipping a grid of small tiles from one image to the next in a ripple that starts where the visitor clicked
visitor_action: click arrows or the image; swipe on touch; a quiet pause control stops auto-advance
motion: tiles flip in a radial wave from the click point with ease-out, a specular glint and a small lift; a slow glint keeps the surface alive (reduced-motion: instant crossfade, no auto-advance until played)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Tile showroom: crisp square tiles with thin warm-grey grout lines, glossy flip highlights, neutral frame
notes: Grid geometry settles after a post-mount measure (first paint uses a 12×8 default grid); render and craft gates were skipped per instruction, so the visual result is unverified.
